stem: One difference between the efforts to preserve the Leaning Tower of Pisa and those of the Cutty Sark is that the efforts related to the Cutty Sark included —

options.label: F
options.text: fixing the structure in a way that allowed it to perform its original function

options.label: G
options.text: finding a way to increase the number of people visiting the structure

options.label: H
options.text: changing the way the structure was displayed

options.label: J
options.text: repairing specific parts of the structure
